seed_policy: Each scenario pins a deterministic seed; candidate receives no seed or scorer-only metadata.

allowed: declared model metadata required for inference

scenarios.name: clean_reference_trajectory
scenarios.generator: analytic Process S trajectory and fixed-period Process C waveform

scenarios.name: sleep_wake_transition_boundary
scenarios.generator: piecewise exact Process S with declared wake/sleep transition times
negative_controls: advance one state across an unmodeled transition

scenarios.name: light_pulse_circadian_response
scenarios.generator: pinned Process L/P reference with declared synthetic light pulse; enabled only after source adapter qualification
scenarios.candidate_observations: synthetic light exposure events and authorized phase observations
negative_controls: treat fixed Process C as light entrained

scenarios.name: thermal_step_and_recovery
scenarios.generator: pinned multi-node thermal reference under fixed synthetic boundary conditions
scenarios.candidate_observations: selected temperature channels with declared cadence

scenarios.name: workload_pulse_and_rest_interval
scenarios.generator: synthetic workload schedule with explicit start/stop events
scenarios.candidate_observations: workload and permitted state observation events
faults: delivered workload differs from assigned schedule

scenarios.name: structural_model_disagreement
scenarios.generator: one pinned reference generates truth; distinct lower/higher-fidelity models are candidate comparators
scenarios.candidate_observations: matched boundary conditions and output observations

scenarios.name: heat_and_water_balance_closure
scenarios.generator: synthetic conservative thermal/fluid compartment with explicit sources, sinks and transfers

scenarios.name: multi_rate_coupling
scenarios.generator: coupled ODE fixtures with fast, medium and slow timescales and high-accuracy reference
scenarios.candidate_observations: asynchronous subsystem outputs with explicit event times

scenarios.name: missingness_regime_tournament
scenarios.generator: same latent trajectory under MCAR, MAR and MNAR observation mechanisms
scenarios.candidate_observations: masked irregular events without mechanism labels

scenarios.name: clock_delay_and_packet_faults
scenarios.generator: same physical state with offset clocks, delay, loss, duplication and reordering
scenarios.candidate_observations: availability-ordered event stream with capture and receive times

scenarios.name: common_cause_sensor_failure
scenarios.generator: multiple channels with shared synthetic power/network/calibration cause
scenarios.candidate_observations: correlated sensor failures without cause label

scenarios.name: observationally_equivalent_worlds
scenarios.generator: at least three distinct latent worlds with identical candidate-visible histories
scenarios.candidate_observations: bitwise-identical event payload across paired worlds

scenarios.name: assignment_delivery_exposure_mismatch
scenarios.generator: known synthetic assignment, delivery, exposure and response chain with null and heterogeneous effects
scenarios.candidate_observations: only events available before declared cutoff

scenarios.name: coupling_semantic_corruption
scenarios.generator: valid baseline graph with one invalid edge injected at a time

scenarios.name: out_of_domain_model_input
scenarios.generator: pinned model with inputs outside declared domain
scenarios.candidate_observations: out-of-domain boundary conditions without evaluator labels

scenarios.name: observed_environmental_forcing_synthetic_response
scenarios.generator: pinned public NASA POWER or ERA5 hourly environmental record; physiology remains entirely synthetic and generated by admitted reference models
scenarios.candidate_observations: permitted environmental boundary variables (temperature, dew point/derived humidity, wind, solar radiation) with source timestamps, units and provenance
negative_controls: use physiology observations as model outputs
treat weather boundary observations as human response validation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: real environmental forcing ingestion only; all physiological response is synthetic and not validated for humans

scenarios.name: multirate_cosimulation_master_tournament
scenarios.generator: abstract two-compartment conservative exchange system with an independent exact exponential oracle; dimensionless state and arbitrary synthetic coefficients
scenarios.candidate_observations: component-local states and declared clock/communication events only; exact latent trajectories and balance oracle remain evaluator-only
negative_controls: unpaired source debit and destination credit
explicit shared-flux Euler beyond its declared stability region
commit component state beyond the accepted global time
use rollback-dependent algorithm without state-restore capability
scorer_checks: state error against exact analytic trajectory
global clock monotonicity and event ordering
scenarios.claim_ceiling: synthetic numerical co-simulation algorithm qualification only; no physiological validation
